title: ui test flake: useDeferredFirstSend's "first send creates one row and is replayed into it" races React's passive-effect flush under load (ejected #36869 from the merge queue)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Filing gate: ① a test defect found by seat repo:objectstack#4 while handling a merge-queue ejection; it blocks the landing of PR #36869 (card #35399, p1). Untriaged: grade, domain and state are triage's.

## Signature

Queue run 45373444137 (`gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-36869-49c6bf3d51…`), job `Test UI (7/16)`:
`FAIL dom packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/useDeferredFirstSend.test.tsx > useDeferredFirstSend — the first send creates the conversation (objectstack#32031) > mounting creates nothing; the first send creates one row and is replayed into it` — `AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times` at `:358` (`expect(doSend).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)` right after `await flushReplay()`).

## Reproduction attempts (seat's diagnosis run, no writes)

On the queue's merged tree (origin/main `49c6bf3d51` + #36869 head `b36be4c714`) and on origin/main alone, after CI's package build step:
- the file alone, 10 runs each tree: 20/20 passed;
- merged tree under CPU load (`--pool forks --maxWorkers=1` plus 6 CPU hogs on 4 cores, load ~11), 10 runs: 10 passed;
- merged tree, the full shard as CI runs it (`pnpm --dir ui run test --shard=7/16`), once: 445 files / 5247 tests, all passed in 649 s (the failing CI shard took 680 s and failed only this test).
#36869's diff does not touch `console/ai/`; its only reach into the test's import closure is one added i18n string per locale.

## Mechanism (read from React and Testing Library source; not force-reproduced)

The hook's replay effect sends the stashed message from a `setTimeout(0)`; the test's `flushReplay()` waits on its own `setTimeout(0)`. `setConversationId('conv-1')` lands after `await res.json()` inside `waitFor`, where RTL has act off; React 19 commits on its scheduler and runs passive effects as a later task (`scheduleCallback(NormalPriority, flushPassiveEffects)`). `waitFor` resolves on the DOM change before the remounted pane's `useEffect` has set the replay timer; RTL's `setTimeout(0)` drain normally covers that gap, but on a starved runner the scheduler can yield past it — then `flushReplay`'s timer is set first, fires first, and `doSend` has 0 calls.

## Fix (test only)

Replace `await flushReplay(); expect(doSend).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)` with `await waitFor(() => expect(doSend).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))` (and the same for any sibling case using `flushReplay()` before a call-count assertion in this file). No product change: the product's ordering is correct; the test's wait is too short.

Dedupe: `useDeferredFirstSend flaky`, `flushReplay`, `queue-signature useDeferredFirstSend` — no open card; the merge-queue triage comment on #36869 (7129251672) counts this the only hit in 24 h.
